_comment: Storyboard map for meta-create-skill VIDEO 8: Build a Harness (CP4 'Make it reliable', second explainer). Rebuilt 2026-09-23 on the locked running example (DESIGN-SYSTEM §9): draft-email/ writes the draft, qa-draft/ is the reviewer (the step in the weekly-email/ system that never saw the draft being written), and the retry cap + the reality check live in weekly-email/, the lead skill. 5 diagrams in teaching order, one column each. Arc: The seam (three bad runs of the hardened skill: the self-check stopped the 34%, a press-release draft and a false 'Done' got through) -> The reviewer, part 1 (the same AI twice: the writer marks its own homework, qa-draft/ reads it cold) -> The reviewer, part 2 (the retry cap: sent back at most 3 times, then it comes to you) -> The reality check (it opens drafts/ and finds it empty, so the job comes back unfinished) -> The assembly (inside the skill: your rules, the self-check, the scorecard; outside it, the harness: 1 reviewer -> 2 retry cap -> 3 reality check -> you, each showing where it lives). THE DECK'S ONE JOB: every slide is about something the skill CANNOT KNOW ABOUT ITSELF. A slide about a stated rule belongs in v7-harden.

columns.label: 1 - HARDENING DID ITS JOB. TWO GOT THROUGH ANYWAY.
2 - THE REVIEWER, PART 1: THE WRITER CAN'T HEAR ITS OWN VOICE
3 - THE REVIEWER, PART 2: SENDS IT BACK THREE TIMES, MAX
4 - "DONE" IS NOT PROOF: THE REALITY CHECK OPENS THE FOLDER
5 - THE SKILL GUARDS ITS RULES. THE HARNESS GUARDS THE REST.
